mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster reports King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 measuring out of spec, and says King technical support confirmed the out-of-spec condition. Also reports the thrust bearing slipping into the cap and block groove too easily, raising a spin risk from lack of interference fit.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the OP reports switching to NOS Clevite thrust bearings that measured in spec.
